reviews.text:
1.Jeil Gongan Cafe Review👍
Located near Seoul Nat’l Univ. Station, Jeil Gongan is a charming, aesthetic cafe with warm wooden tones and beautiful natural lighting. The cozy, comfortable atmosphere makes it a perfect place to relax by the window and enjoy the view. Their pairing of baked goods and coffee is simply excellent. 😍
2.Grain Cream Latte Review
The Grain Cream Latte made with a blend of four grains was incredibly nutty and flavorful. The rich cream complements the coffee perfectly, leaving a unique, earthy taste that lingers in your mind. ☕

3.Desserts Review
Jeil Gongan offers a wide variety of desserts, especially their famous baked goods. Next time, I’m definitely going to try more of them! 🍰

4.Cafe Atmosphere
Jeil Gongan has a beautiful and serene vibe, making it the perfect place for some quiet time alone. The atmosphere itself is truly healing and peaceful. 🌿💫

1.🪽Jeil Space Cafe Review🪵
Jeil Space near Seoul National University Station is a cafe with an emotional atmosphere. I love the warm wood-toned interior and the natural light coming through the large windows. If you sit by the window in a cozy and comfortable atmosphere, you can relax while looking at the outside scenery. The combination of baked snacks and coffee is great. 😍

2. Gotgan Cream Latte Review
The cream latte made with grain misut powder was really nutty and delicious. The cream made from four different grains goes well with coffee, and I keep thinking about its unique, savory flavor. ☕😋

3. Dessert review
There are many different desserts at Jeil Space. They are especially famous for their baked snacks, and I definitely want to try more desserts next time! 🍰

4. Cafe atmosphere
Jeil Space, which is beautiful and full of emotion, has a quiet and comfortable atmosphere, making it perfect for spending time alone. It is a place where the atmosphere alone can heal you. 🌿💫

190427 visits
It's one of the few instant tteokbokki restaurants on Lunar New Year's Day. Of course, Mukshi Donna is back, but... it's still a good restaurant with good accessibility and cost-effectiveness. You can eat tteokbokki for 2 people for around 15,000 won (basic gogo tteokbokki is 125,000 won, cheese, etc. are 1,000 to 2,000 won more expensive). You can choose between mild/slightly spicy/spicy, and the slightly spicy flavor here is not that spicy. Even though I'm not good at eating spicy food, I enjoyed the slightly spicy flavor haha.
I ordered Gogo Instant Tteokbokki for 2 people. Ramen and Jjolmyeonsari are included as standard, 2 fried dumplings, 2 seaweed rolls, 2 eggs, cabbage rice cake, fish cake, and green onions. The rice cakes are small, but the fish cakes are large. The rice cakes are chewy and delicious. The unfortunate thing is that the fried dumplings and seaweed rolls have a high proportion of fried batter, so you may think they are a bit greasy. The amount of ramen and jjolmyeonsari is quite large.. I recommend eating it right away. It goes down quickly.
And they fry rice for 2,000 won, which is another delicacy. Even if you fry just one bowl, the amount is huge. The batter is really good value for money. For a dinner that reminds me of tteokbokki, try Gogo tteokbokki.
The taste is about 4 stars, but I'll give it an extra star because it's good value for money. May you prosper.

#Sharosu-gil Cafe Yongma Coffee is a complex cultural space where dragons and horses coexist, and an exhibition cafe closely related to daily life. I've seen this cafe a lot in passing, but I thought 'I should go there' but couldn't go because the coronavirus got worse. I finally stopped by because I wanted some dessert after going out to work.

There are also photo zones with various concepts, but it's a shame that only takeout is available. If you want to take Instagram photos, you may want to take a lot of them at the Yongma Coffee photo zone.

I originally wanted to eat a dessert cake, Crople, but there wasn't anything I liked about the cake, and they said Crople would take some time, so I ordered coffee that comes out quickly.

The black sesame latte was 6,000 won, but it was on a 15% discount for takeout, so I got a 900 won discount. The black sesame latte has black sesame seeds sinking at the bottom, and when mixed with coffee, it has a subtle, sweet taste.

To celebrate the new year, we are also selling cakes with cute cows on them, so please take note. #Self-Employed Fighting

My menu is black sesame latte (5,100 won)

reviews.text:
Horido, a craft beer restaurant located on Sharosu-gil, Seoul National University Station.
It is a short walk from the Wondang Elementary School entrance intersection and is located at the corner of the three-way intersection on the main street of Sharosu-gil, so the round-shaped building is easy to find.
Horido is a place that is serious about soccer games. There is a large screen on one wall that shows live soccer games on a beam projector, so you can watch the game while drinking beer. On the day I visited, Korea and Thailand were playing a match.
Since I stopped by for the second time after eating and drinking, I only ordered beer and nachos, but the portion was large and the sauce was delicious.
The prices for beer and snacks are reasonable, the staff is friendly, and it's good for conversation, and the atmosphere is nice. I plan to visit again soon to try main snacks and craft beer.
